description: This Java interface defines a contract for creating custom HTML sanitizer policies within the Ofbiz framework. It includes a default policy implementation using OWASP's HtmlPolicyBuilder and a method to retrieve the custom policy.

classes.name: SanitizerCustomPolicy
classes.description: A Java interface for building custom sanitizer policies for HTML content.

methods.name: getSanitizerPolicy
methods.description: Abstract method to return the PolicyFactory representing the custom sanitizer policy.
